training.selection: minimum dev action-token cross-entropy over epochs (unchanged from v0.3)

dagger.learner: bc arm of the same training seed
dagger.label_rule: keep a state only if the teacher, continuing from exactly that state, passes grader v2
dagger.size_match: bc-volume and dagger add the same number of rows to the shared train_core expert rows: min(expert rows on train_pool, verified DAgger rows); uniform deterministic subsample with the training seed

base-0.6b.role: matched base for all 0.6B LoRA arms

v03-lora.role: transfer of the published adapters to independent records

bc.role: behaviour cloning on independent, slot-balanced records

dagger.data: expert(train_core) + verified DAgger labels at bc-learner states on train_pool
dagger.role: on-policy state distribution, same size as bc-volume

notes: Arms may be added on dev (e.g. a stronger thinking-mode baseline) before the test lock; nothing is added or tuned after it.
